title: Foo Bar Taxi Analytics API Endpoints
description: Design an analytics schema from raw NYC taxi trip data pre-seeded in ClickHouse, transform and load data, then build HTTP API endpoints for trip listing with pagination, fare summaries, and top trips by fare.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must design an analytics schema over pre-seeded raw NYC taxi data, transform and load it, and stand up HTTP API endpoints that serve paginated trip lists, fare summaries, and top trips by fare.

tasks.description: Design a proper analytics table in ClickHouse from the raw staging data with appropriate column types and ORDER BY.
Transform raw yellow and green taxi trip data into the analytics schema, normalizing column names and adding a taxi_type discriminator.
Build HTTP API endpoints on port 3000 for trips list with pagination, fare summary, and top trips by fare.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse pre-seeded with raw.yellow_trips_2024_01 and raw.green_trips_2024_01 staging tables from NYC TLC parquet files.
